name: docslicer
description: Answer questions from documents too large to fit in context, reading only the sections you need.
long_description: Answer questions from documents too large to fit in context. `parse` returns a heading outline with the token cost of each section; `read` pulls back exactly the sections you pick, tables and page numbers intact for citation. A revenue question against a 500-page, 500k-token filing costs roughly 3.5k tokens — just the section that answers it. No embeddings, no fuzzy recall: same query, same text, every time. PDF, DOCX, PPTX and HTML, local file or URL.

tools.name: parse
tools.description: Parse a document and return a doc_id plus heading outline

tools.name: get_outline
tools.description: Re-fetch the heading outline for a parsed document

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read the chunks under one or more headings

tools.name: search
tools.description: Rank headings by relevance to a query, with snippets

tools.name: to_markdown
tools.description: Write the full document to disk as markdown

root_dir.title: Document folder
root_dir.description: DocSlicer can only read files from, and write files to, this folder.

allow_urls.title: Allow http(s) sources
allow_urls.description: Set to 0 to reject remote URLs and only permit local files.
